# VaultyLink

> VaultyLink is an end-to-end encrypted vault to save, organize and protect all your important links across desktop and web.

VaultyLink uses AES-256-GCM client-side encryption so only you can read your data. Available on Windows, macOS and the web.

- [Home](/): Product overview, features and pricing.
- [Sign in](/auth): Create an account or log in with email, Google or Apple.
- [Privacy Policy](/privacy): How data is handled and protected.
